sentence: This project studies how different plant species repeatedly develop red flowers and which genetic changes control this trait.
This project tests how the size, density and stiffness of nanoparticles implanted in the skin affect how safe they are for the body.
This project builds methods that learn the mathematical operations needed to store and represent multiway data more accurately.
This project studies how external datasets and pretrained models enter biological workflows and how flaws in them change scientific conclusions.
This project builds a 3D printed battery that both powers and bends a soft robot so it can move untethered.
This project studies how well standard statistical methods work on large complex datasets and how much data they need.
This project carries out nanotechnology research on flexible electronics, nanomotors, batteries and environmental filtration.
This project trains a machine learning system to estimate body pose, motion and forces from video cameras.
This project builds a wearable glove and a game that measure hand movements to judge fine motor skills in children with autism.
This project develops ways to track hand motion and understand how hands interact with objects using wearable cameras.
This project studies a sea squirt from the Antarctic and the microbes living with it, including a natural product the microbes make.
This project supports a conference on membranes used to separate chemicals, including for desalination, gas separation and batteries.
This project supports a conference on security methods that stay trustworthy when quantum computing exists.
This project builds tiny light-responsive particles that enter nerve cells, turn off pain-signaling receptors and emit light to show where.
This project studies how to update facts stored in large language models so the updates work reliably in related contexts.
This project provides a next-generation sequencing instrument for use in biology, forensic science and environmental science classes.
